theme: An open day — board-search momentum and holiday logistics are the live threads.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar today, Dan, so the day is yours. The two threads worth pulling are Brunswick's follow-up and the holiday travel bookings.

needsAttention.title: Brunswick wants a second call set up
needsAttention.detail: Erika Maass wrote this morning that Christian would like another 30 minutes and is waiting on your availability over the coming week.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority task, open since mid-September: a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week, before holiday inventory sells out.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break plan
needsAttention.detail: The decide-by and book-by dates have both passed; three holiday weeks for six needs a destination chosen and refundable bookings held.

flagged.title: Two board-adjacent roles in today's alerts
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced an Executive Director, Corporate Strategy role at Estée Lauder and a Managing Partner opening at Synergy Management Group.

inbox.noise: Otherwise mostly newsletters and receipts — the Guardian, Portland Press Herald, a Substack receipt, and utility and travel notices.

resolved.title: Toronto comp ticket sorted
resolved.detail: Claudia at ICGN confirmed she registered your complimentary place for the Autumn Conference — the ticket you raised with Jen is handled.

resolved.title: Plenary 7 questions reworked
resolved.detail: Flo confirmed she and Rachit reshaped the panel questions toward the commercial angle he wanted; your run of show stands and the panelists have signed off.

resolved.title: NACD New England Maine event wrapped
resolved.detail: The directors' event in Portland on Tuesday is done, and the feedback circulating afterward was positive on the panel and moderation.

recipe.why: A warming, slow-cooked dish for autumn, when roots and orchard fruit are at their best.

acts.line: No meetings on the books — the day opened completely clear in St. Pete.
Still nothing scheduled; a rare uninterrupted stretch to spend as you choose.
A quiet close with the girls home — an easy evening before next week ramps up.
